rationale: Consolidate the requested Northern Virginia data-center joint-venture label into the existing canonical QSP record and correct its disclosed current-owner set. Wren House and BlackRock are direct investors, while QTS retained a minority ownership and operating role under upstream owner Blackstone. The three stabilized Northern Virginia facilities total approximately 100 MW; exact direct ownership percentages and legal investing vehicles are not publicly disclosed. Task 491 remains pending until this correction is applied and production-verified.

companyFieldUpdates.description: QSP is a joint venture that owns three fully constructed and fully leased hyperscale data centers in Northern Virginia. The portfolio provides approximately 100 MW of critical IT capacity and is operated by QTS. Wren House and BlackRock completed their majority investment in November 2024, while QTS retained a minority ownership interest and the operating role under upstream owner Blackstone. Exact direct ownership percentages, the joint venture's full legal name and the legal investing vehicles are not publicly disclosed.
